verdict.rationale: Published pricing is a fair question for an immigration law firm. Daryanani Law Group's site evidence lists its visa services (O-1, H-1B, E-3, L-1, EB-1 and others) but shows no flat fees, price menu or any dollar figures. Without pricing evidence, a founder cannot see real costs before contacting the firm.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see real prices before I talk to anyone — published flat fees or a priced service menu on the provider's own site
